intended_object: An auxiliary map used inside a proof. For t in [0,1], it sends a point (x,y,z) of the twice-punctured 2-sphere to the vector (x,y,t·z) in ℝ³. This is the un-normalized first step of the homotopy that deformation-retracts the punctured sphere onto its equator (inferred from the docstring and from the next definition, sphere2PunctureIntersectionRadialVector).
explanation: This is a technical device inside a homotopy construction: the vector before normalization, used to build a deformation retraction of S² minus the two poles onto the equator. It has no standalone counterpart in the literature. The body does what the docstring says: it keeps the first two coordinates and multiplies the third by t. The library proves the vector is never zero (sphere2PunctureIntersectionLinearVector_ne_zero), which is what the later normalization step needs.
